item_changes.comment: Revision required only for the rationale. The prerequisite coverage is now adequate through symmetric-matrices-and-definiteness, but the rationale incorrectly says the positive-definite Hessian condition is represented by RC-002 and RC-003 even though RC-003 is not a dependency. State instead that RC-002 supplies stationarity, RC-027 supplies the Newton iteration, and the external definiteness concept supplies interpretation of the positive-definite Hessian hypothesis.

Revision required. RC-013 is correctly classified as an implementation dependency, but RC-030 lists two external concepts for the same inverse-Hessian knowledge. Retain exactly one required, narrowly scoped inverse-Hessian-approximation concept and remove the duplicate reference; then align the rationale with that single concept.
